notes.subject: Event remains active; one 2024 recipient was invalid
notes.body: Adventure Zone's Dec. 2023 outreach included idfinn@sm-email.com and harrison.id.info@gmail.com; the idfinn address failed with a 550 unknown-user error. Current Kootenai County and North Idaho event listings confirm Harrison Old Time Picnic remains active and family-focused, with the 2026 picnic in Harrison City Park and traditional games/parade activities. Verify the current city/event organizer before any future outreach rather than reusing the failed address.

followUps.label: Verify 2027 Harrison Old Time Picnic contact
followUps.reason: The event is still active but the old primary recipient failed. Confirm the current organizer/contact and whether a larger staffed attraction would fit the traditional community picnic before outreach.
